title: Janjehli and Shikari Devi: Mandi's Quiet Valley and the Roofless Temple on the Hilltop
seo_title: Janjehli & Shikari Devi Temple: Snow, Trek & How to Reach
seo_desc: Janjehli valley in Mandi district and the Shikari Devi temple (about 3,330 m), famous for having no roof: the road and trek to the top, snow from December to March, when the temple is closed, and how to reach from Mandi and Shimla.
focus: janjehli, shikari devi temple, janjehli valley
